Definition: to overflow (specifically with oil.); by implication, to mix; to fodder
BiblicalUsage: 1) to mix, mingle, confuse, confound; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to mingle, confuse; 1a2) to mix; 1a3) to give provender, feed (animals); 1b) (Hithpoel) to mix oneself (among others); 1c) (Hiphil) to fade away
